senses.gloss: m. (v. סְאֵב) fibrous substance, esp. bast of the palm-tree.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Oktzin 1:2">Ukts. I, 2</cite> <he>הס׳ שלו</he> the fibrous root of the radish.
<cite ref="Pesachim 115b:6">Pes. 115ᵇ</cite> <he>כרכן בס׳</he> if he wrapped them up in bast.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sukkah 1:6:1">Y. Succ. I, 52ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>חבלים של ס׳</he> ropes of bast; a. fr.—Pl. <he>סִיבִים</he>, <he>סִיבִין</he>.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 41:1">Gen. R. s. 41</cite>, beg.; <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 3:1">Num. R. s. 3</cite>, beg. <he>ס׳ לחבלים</he> the bast of the palm-tree is used for making ropes; a. e.—[<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 841:3">Yalk. Ps. 841</cite> <he>סיב קמלפי</he>, v. <cite ref="O00545"><he>סִיבַק</he></cite>.]
